about: Settler work animations, 16-bit people tier (art/people16.js looks). Painted at runtime per look by src/art/work16.js registerWorkWalker(scene, look, walkerKey); the PNGs here are baked samples (one look per kit) + the load layer. Coordinates are frame pixels (16x18, origin = walker anchor (8,17) via FOOT). left = mirrored right.
